decoded_float32_stereo_algorithm: sum unique runtime sample frame_count * 2 output channels * 4-byte float32; mono sources are expanded to stereo by read_audio_float
sample_enumeration: constructed the instrument and walked its loaded sample regions; hashes cover exactly the files the engine reads at run time
sample_set_hash_algorithm: sort unique asset-root-relative UTF-8 paths; concatenate lowercase '<sha256>  <path>\n>'; SHA-256 the UTF-8 bytes
